name: Randy March
source:
Likes: Cute things, sweets and Taffy!
Dislikes: Any magic possibly endanger or hurt people
Hobby: Studying and experimenting in the fields of magic and wizardry
Skill: Competitive speed eating of sweets!

"There's no failure or right or wrong answers in magic."

Taffy: He is my master Randy! My master made me and gave me a life! He's the most genius wizard of all!
But he is always busy studying and experimenting magic, and that makes people think he's crazy and eccentric...
Me sometimes help my master's experiment!
Sometimes...I mean most of the time, me have hard time helping it. But! Me do my best to help my master! I love my master Randy a lot!!

[Official in-game description (Main Story)]
